description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorMetricsPoller class, which polls and tracks executor metrics in Apache Spark, maintaining peaks per task and stage, and providing updates for heartbeats.

classes.name: ExecutorMetricsPoller
classes.description: A class that polls executor metrics, tracks peaks per task and stage, and provides updates for Spark executor heartbeats.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls current executor metrics and updates peak values for stages and tasks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the polling thread if pollingInterval > 0.

methods.name: onTaskStart
methods.description: Registers a new task, initializing its metric peaks and updating stage task count.

methods.name: onTaskCompletion
methods.description: Marks task completion, decrementing stage task count and removing task peaks.

methods.name: getTaskMetricPeaks
methods.description: Retrieves the peak metrics for a specific task.

methods.name: getExecutorUpdates
methods.description: Returns current stage metrics updates and resets peaks for next interval.
